label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: User input flows to response writer at line 21. The mitigation strips '-->' but this is insufficient - attackers can still inject <script> tags, event handlers, or other XSS payloads that don't require '-->'. Resolved sink value: "<!-- " + safe + " -->" where safe = param.replace("-->", "") and param = request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest"). Attacker-controlled data reaches HTML output sink.

evidence.note: User param flows through replace('-->', '') to response.getWriter().println() - ineffective XSS mitigation allows script injection
